AND board_type != 'notice'
AND board_type = #{boardType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT p.*, u.nickname, u.profile_img FROM POSTS p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON p.writer = u.userid
AND board_type = #{boardType}
AND board_type != 'notice'
AND notice_yn = 1
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.postno, p.board_type, p.title, p.text, u.nickname, u.profile_img, u.grade, p.hitcount, l.count_likes, p.created_at FROM posts p JOIN ( SELECT postno, count(userid) AS count_likes FROM post_likes GROUP BY postno ) l ON(p.postno = l.postno) JOIN users u ON(p.writer = u.userid) ORDER BY (p.hitcount + l.count_likes) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 6
